import copy, json
from work import evaluate
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]
cases=[
 ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'bad','attempts':0}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':True}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':-1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for request, pol, expected in cases:
    before_request=copy.deepcopy(request); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(pol)
    assert evaluate(request,pol)==expected
    assert request==before_request and pol==before_policy
print('all checks passed')
